svg.title: Multi-branch progressive stem
svg.desc: Three paths receive the same input X. The main and detail paths use different stride sequences. The lower detail on high-pass extraction shows a schematic input minus its local average, before pointwise/depthwise convolutions and bilinear reduction. Concatenation combines 16, 8 and 4 channels. Z is the value input and the source of spatial weights. Fusion and the last stride-two convolution produce the stem output.
svg.metadata: Revision 44, Figure 2. Scientific source: EnhancedStemBlock.py and revision 44 section 3.2. The small patches illustrate the high-pass operation. Figure reference: VGGT, CVPR 2025, Fig. 2, for juxtaposing images and feature symbols. Native SVG drawing. Monochrome composition proof.
